_comment: Lightweight housemate interactions. Two creators relaxing in the same shared (non-private) room roll an interaction every 'interval_minutes'. Weights are scaled by personality: 'positive' interactions by average charisma/50 and existing friendship, 'negative' ones by average drama/50 (squared) and existing rivalry. Effects change friendship/trust/rivalry (0..100) and both creators' mood; a reaction bubble shows for 'bubble_minutes'. Romance, jealousy and other storylines are later milestones.

interactions.label: hanging out
interactions.text: %s and %s are hanging out on the couch.

interactions.label: celebrating
interactions.text: %s and %s are celebrating a great day!
